children: Bains brings talent acquisition and people leadership experience from Edelman, Reliance Brands, Paytm and other organisations

Kanika Bains has been appointed as VP & Head – People & Culture at MSL India, part of Publicis Groupe. She brings extensive experience across talent acquisition, people and culture, employer branding and HR leadership.

Bains joins MSL India from Edelman, where she served as Vice President – Talent Acquisition. Her previous roles include Head – Talent Acquisition at Reliance Brands Limited and multiple talent acquisition positions at Paytm, where she worked as Deputy General Manager, Assistant General Manager, Senior Manager and Manager.

Earlier in her career, Bains served as Senior Executive – Corporate HR at 94.3 MY FM – Synergy Media Entertainment Ltd. – Dainik Bhaskar Group, followed by HR Executive roles at Times OOH and Bennett Coleman & Co. Ltd. (The Times of India).
Her career has spanned talent acquisition, people and culture, employer branding and broader HR responsibilities across media, technology, retail and communications organisations.
With her new role at MSL India, Bains takes on the People & Culture mandate for the organisation, bringing experience across talent leadership and HR functions.
